paras: If you're not a fan of overly loud systems but feel the OEM exhaust is a little too quiet for your liking, The Xforce Resonator delete kit is perfect for you. A simple kit designed to replace the factory resonator, will add a little more volume, enhance the iconic DSG shift characteristics and accentuate engine sounds across the rev range.

This resonator delete pipe is designed to only fit MK7 GTI Models with a 65mm (2.56") factory catback exhaust, and WILL NOT fit models equipped with a 60mm (2.36") factory catback exhaust, including the Performance Edition 1 (PE1), the Rabbit Edition and the MK8 GTI. This resonator delete pipe is also not compatible with other aftermarket exhaust systems.
ft: XForce VW Golf GTI MK7 and MK7.5 Resonator Delete Pipe
